notes: Address the user politely with "आप" and polite imperatives (करें, चुनें, सहेजें, हटाएँ); buttons are short verb phrases, headings/labels are nouns without a full stop. Full sentences end with the danda (।); keep ?, !, :, …, and the em dash (—) as in English. Use curly double quotes “ ”. Use Western digits. Prefer common, natural Hindi over heavily Sanskritised terms; well-established tech loanwords are written in Devanagari with nukta (फ़ॉन्ट, फ़ाइल, डिज़ाइन, ऑफ़लाइन, साइन इन, अपलोड, कॉपी). Chandrabindu spellings (हाँ, जाएँ, कहानियाँ). Errors follow "… नहीं हो सका — फिर से कोशिश करें". "interior" (the book's inside pages) = "अंदरूनी पृष्ठ"; "page" = "पृष्ठ" ("पन्ने" for physical sheets). Option names on Lulu's English-only site and Google Fonts' button names stay in English.
